Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National Video: Daniel-Kofi Kyereh spotted in Ghana ahead of Black Stars AFCON qualifier doubleheader against Somalia Source : Lawrence Degraft Baidoo 8 November 2026 11:10pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Ghana international Daniel-Kofi Kyereh has been spotted in Accra ahead of the Black Stars squad announcement for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifiers against Somalia.
The VfL Osnabrück midfielder was seen at the Accra International Airport on Sunday evening with the Black Stars set to open camp ahead of the upcoming games.
Daniel-Kofi Kyereh returns to the blacks stars squad after a long absence with injury https://t.co/rV76D7raky
The midfielder's presence is linked to a possible recall to the national team after returning from a long-term injury at the start of the 2026/27 season.
Kyereh has three goal contributions in nine games for his club this season, scoring two goals and setting up another in the 2. Bundesliga.
The Black Stars face Somalia on November 12 and 16, looking to get the AFCON qualifcation hopes alive after defeats to Cote d'Ivoire and Gambia.
